items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A slot in the door opens and a pair of wild eyes peer out.*#WHITE#
What do you want, @playerdescriptor.race@?
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*门上开了一个小洞，一副野蛮的眼睛凝视着你。*#WHITE#
你想干什么，@playerdescriptor.race@？

items.source: Paladin Aeryn told me that you could help me. I need to get to Maj'Eyal.
items.target: 太阳骑士艾琳跟我说你能帮助我，我想去马基·埃亚尔。

items.source: I found the Blood-Runed Athame, but there was no Resonating Diamond.
items.target: 我找到了血符仪式匕首，不过没找到共鸣钻石。

items.source: I have a Resonating Diamond.
items.target: 我找到了共鸣钻石。

items.source: Sorry, I have to go!
items.target: 抱歉，我要走了！

items.source:
Pfaugh! Her goal in life is to waste my time! Maj'Eyal? Why not Narnia or Chicago? Just as easy to send you someplace entirely fictional as Maj'Eyal. Go away.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Slot slams shut.*#WHITE#
items.target:
呸！她的生活目标就是在浪费我的时间！马基·埃亚尔？怎么不是纳尼亚或者芝加哥？就像送你到小说里的马基·埃亚尔一样简单，走开。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*小洞呯的一声关上了。*#WHITE#

items.source: I got here from Maj'Eyal, didn't I? I have this magic Orb I looted from a dead orc, see, and...
items.target: 我来自马基·埃亚尔，不是么，我有一个从一个兽人尸体上找到的魔法水晶球，看……

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Slot opens.*#WHITE#
Orb, you say? That you used to travel here from Maj'Eyal? Surely you don't possess the Orb of Many Ways! It's been lost for ages!
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*小洞打开了。*#WHITE#
你说水晶球？你说你是从马基·埃亚尔来的？你拿到的肯定不是多元水晶球！它已经消失很多年了！

items.source: [Hold up the orb]
items.target: [拿出水晶球]

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*His eyes widen.*#WHITE#
Great Socks of Aeryn! It IS the Orb! Maybe we can get you home after all. Or maybe we can get you embedded in magma a thousand leagues straight down.
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他瞪大了眼睛*#WHITE#
艾琳的袜子啊！真是那个水晶球！说不定我们可以让你回家，说不准也可以给你在熔岩深渊中安个家。

items.source: May I come in?
items.target: 我能进来了么？

items.source:
You think I'm letting some filthy @playerdescriptor.race@ in my house with the Orb of Many Ways?
I blow myself up quite enough already without that thing in the house, thank you.
Besides, I still can't help you unless you have a Blood-Runed Athame to etch a portal.
Err, and that portal must be etched on a piece of prepared Resonating Marble.
The Gates of the Morning has a slab of Marble that once could have served, but a number of, um, incidents have taken their toll.
It'll require a Resonating Diamond to get it properly prepared. Oh, and I want 100 gold.
items.target:
你认为我会让一个肮脏的 @playerdescriptor.race@ 带着多元水晶球进我家么？
谢了，没有那东西在屋里，我已经够经常把自己炸得够呛了。
况且，我没法帮助你，除非你搞到一把血符仪式匕首来开启这个传送门。
呃……要想把它准备好，传送门必须刻在一块准备好的共鸣大理石上。
晨曦之门原本有一块这样的共鸣大理石，不过过去发生过一些……呃……事故，对它造成了损伤。
要想妥善处理它，还需要一块共鸣钻石，哦，我还要收取 100 金币费用。

items.source: Where can I find all that?
items.target: 我上哪儿去找那些东西？

items.source: Try your purse for the 100 gold. As for an Athame and a Resonating Diamond, I assume the orcs have some if they're cooking up portals to use that Orb on. Try the Vor Armory. It so happens that I know a back way in. Never mind why.
items.target: 100 金币嘛……你摸摸自己的钱袋就有了。至于仪式匕首和共鸣钻石，既然那些兽人正准备配合多元水晶球开启传送门，我猜他们手上就有。去沃尔军械库找找吧。碰巧我知道一条后门，别问为什么。

items.source: Thank you.
items.target: 谢谢。

items.source: Of course there was no Resonating Diamond. What makes you think Briagh would let one loose for even a second?
items.target: 你当然找不到共鸣钻石，你想想布莱亚弗怎么可能让一颗钻石溜走？

items.source: Briagh?
items.target: 布莱亚弗？

items.source: Briagh the Great Sand Wyrm. Where do you think Resonating Diamonds come from? They're just regular diamonds until they get stuck between Briagh's scales for a few centuries and get infused with his life rhythms. He sleeps on a hoard of precious gems and metals, you see.
items.target: 布莱亚弗，那条巨型土龙，要不然你认为共鸣钻石是哪里来的？它们原本只是普通的钻石，卡在布莱亚弗的鳞片间长达几个世纪，逐渐被灌注了生命活力。你看，它正是睡在一堆矿石和宝石上呢。

items.source: Where might I find Briagh's lair??
items.target: 布莱亚弗的老巢在什么地方？？

items.source: Well south of the Sunwall. I'll mark it for you on your map.
items.target: 在太阳堡垒的南面，我会在你的地图上给你做个记号。

items.source: I'll be back with a Resonating Diamond.
items.target: 我会带回共鸣钻石。

items.source: Yes? You got the Athame, the gem and 100 gold?
items.target: 怎么，你拿到仪式匕首、宝石和 100 金币了？

items.source: [Give him the gem, the athame and 100 gold]
items.target: [把宝石、仪式匕首和 100 金币交给他]

items.source: Sorry, it seems I lack some stuff. I will be back.
items.target: 抱歉，我去拿点材料，马上回来。

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The door opens and a shabby Elf emerges.*#WHITE#
Off we go to prepare the portal!
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*门开了，一个衣衫褴褛的精灵走了出来。*#WHITE#
我们去准备制造传送门吧！

items.source: [follow him]
items.target: [跟着他]

items.source:
@playername@, you are called to serve. The nearby unhallowed morass inhabitants are growing restless.
You must go there and find the source.
items.target:
@playername@，你效力的时候到了。附近混沌之沼中的怪物们正在蠢蠢欲动。
你最好尽快过去，找到这一切的源头。

items.source: I will, Grand Keeper.
items.target: 我会的，伟大的守护者。

items.source: I am sorry, but I cannot do that.
items.target: 抱歉，我不能这么做。

items.source: Welcome @playername@ to my shop.
items.target: @playername@，欢迎来到我的商店。

items.source: Let me see your wares.
items.target: 让我看看你的商品吧。

items.source: I am looking for mindstar training.
items.target: 我是来学习灵晶掌握的

items.source: Sorry, I have to go!
items.target: 抱歉，我要走了！

items.source: I can teach you mindstar mastery (talent category Wild-gift/Mindstar mastery).  Learning the basics costs 100 gold, while more intensive training to gain proficiency costs 500 gold.  Once you're proficient, I can teach you some additional skills for 750 gold.
items.target: 我能教授你灵晶掌握（自然/灵晶掌握 技能树）。学会基础消耗100金币，想学的更多就得花上500金币。当你学会之后，只要750金币，我就能传授你一些进阶技巧。

items.source: Just give me the basics (reveals locked talent category) - 100 gold.
items.target: 只学习基础（揭示锁定的技能树）- 100 金币。

items.source: The shopkeeper spends some time with you, teaching you the basics of channeling energy through mindstars.
items.target: 商人花了一些时间，教授你使用灵晶的基础技巧

items.source: He is impressed with your affinity for natural forces.
items.target: 他对你同自然力量的亲和度感到惊讶

items.source: Please teach me what I need to know (unlocks talent category) - 500 gold.
items.target: 请教授我需要知道的一切（解锁技能树）- 500 金币。

items.source: The shopkeeper spends a great deal of time going over the finer details of channeling energy through mindstars with you.
items.target: 商人花了大量时间，教授你使用灵晶的全部技巧。

items.source: He is impressed with your mastery and shows you a few tricks to handle stronger energy flows.
items.target: 他对你已经掌握的知识印象深刻，并展示给你一些应付更强大能量流的技巧

items.source: I'm already proficient, but I want to be an expert (improves talent mastery by 0.2) - 750 gold.
items.target: 我已经学会了，但我想成为一名专家。(增加技能树系数0.2) - 750 金币。

items.source: The shopkeeper spends a great deal of time going over the finer details of channeling energy through mindstars with you%s.
items.target: 商人花了大量时间，教授你使用灵晶的全部技巧%s。

items.source: , and teaches you enhanced mental discipline needed to maintain powerful energy fields
items.target: ，并传授你维持强大能量场所需的强化精神修养

items.source: No thanks.
items.target: 不用了，谢谢。
